He put his palm against the stone and answered, very quietly, Mother.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘放慢航速的船。路灯照着空荡的街口，雨水在井盖旁积成细碎的金光。早餐铺卷起铁门，蒸汽先于人声漫过台阶。清洁工推着车，扫走昨夜留下的纸屑。远处一辆公交驶出车场，车窗映着尚未褪尽的月色。某扇窗忽然亮起，有人开始生活，也有人终于准备睡去。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same steps on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that holds a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
